verdict.rationale: Vercel is documented throughout as a managed cloud platform, and nothing in the evidence shows the core platform can be self-hosted. The Apache-2.0 vercel/vercel repo covers only the CLI and framework builders. The Build Output API, local environment replication via the CLI, and the separate eve framework running locally are adjacent features, not self-hosting of Vercel itself. A community comment about moving to a self-hosted alternative (Dokploy) does not count as product support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
